semanticFindings: The six nominal PriorityScore weights cannot be interpreted as the total relative importance of the six factors in Formal selection.
Setup, sector, RR and fundamental exert influence before the composite is even calculated.
RR, sector and RS can influence lexicographic ranking again after PriorityScore.
All PriorityScore-contained components can affect planned capital after selection because allocation is score-proportional.
Institutional score has an additional conditional gate in the 10-30bn market-cap exception.
Signal grade is not an overall-quality grade; it is setup-quality only.
